solution:
Composing,
$$f(f(x))=\frac{1}{\frac{1}{x-1}-1}=\frac{1}{\frac{1-(x-1)}{x-1}}=\frac{x-1}{2-x}.$$
Now solve $\dfrac{x-1}{2-x}=x$ (with $x\neq1,2$):
$$x-1=x(2-x)=2x-x^2\quad\Rightarrow\quad x^2-x-1=0.$$
Hence $x=\dfrac{1\pm\sqrt5}{2}$. Both values avoid the excluded points, so they are the solutions.
